answer: Each identity deposits one heirloom kernel, sealed in a numbered velvet pouch, in a registered seed vault. Each epoch the warden opens the vault, plants a sample kernel from each pouch and checks it sprouts, striking any identity whose seed is dead or duplicated. One fake costs about $310 for a genuine heirloom kernel plus a vault slot, and vault slots are scarce, so the price climbs with every extra fake.
